translation_snapshot.source:
After walking many hours, you finally reach the end of the way. You are nearly on top of one of the highest peaks you can see.
The storm is raging above your head.
translation_snapshot.target:
在行走了几个小时后，你终于到达了终点。你站在了你能看到的最高峰位置。
风暴在你的头顶肆虐。

translation_snapshot.source:
A farportal is a way to travel incredible distances in the blink of an eye. They usually require an external item to use. You have no idea if it is even two-way.
This one seems to go to the Iron Throne in the West.
translation_snapshot.target:
传送门是可以在眨眼间将你传送出很远距离的工具。它们通常需要一件关键道具来激活。你不知道这道门是否为双向的。
 这道门似乎通向西方的钢铁王座。

translation_snapshot.source:
Conjures up a bolt of fire that moves toward the target and explodes into a flash of fire, doing %0.2f fire damage in a radius of %d.
		The damage will increase with your Spellpower.
translation_snapshot.target:
向你的目标发射一枚爆裂火球，造成 %0.2f 火焰伤害，有效范围 %d 码。
		伤害受法术强度加成。

translation_snapshot.source: You arrive in a small underground structure. There are orcs there and as soon as they notice you they scream 'Protect the mothers!'.
translation_snapshot.target: 你来到了一个小型地下建筑前。那里有着许多兽人，当他们注意到你时，他们叫道“保护母亲们！”。

translation_snapshot.source: The target is lost in a nightmare that deals %0.2f darkness damage each turn and has a %d%% chance to cause a random detrimental effect.
translation_snapshot.target: 目标陷入清醒状态的噩梦之中，每回合造成 %0.2f 暗影伤害，并有 %d%% 概率受到一个随机不良效果。

translation_snapshot.source: Mastery of folding points in space.
